subject: CAIQ scope clarification and evidence handover window
messages:
From: Ava Patel <security@cognify.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ sync — scope & log samples request

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Attached is the CAIQ questionnaire (annotated) that Solstice Health needs completed for our procurement review. There are three control areas where we will need runtime evidence / log samples for our security team to validate isolation and key management claims:

- IAM / multi-tenant isolation (tenant-id separation traces, example request/response lines)
- Key lifecycle & rotation (KMS activity logs showing rotation events + key ARN mapping)
- Telemetry & retention (ingestion traces and TTL enforcement examples for inference logs)

Could you confirm:
1) Which control owners at Redwood will provide each evidence artifact?
2) Whether you can provide a timeboxed, encrypted bundle (SFTP or signed S3 URL) with redacted PII for the samples?
3) Proposed window for the handover (we need the artifacts ingested into our portal by Nov 3).

I've attached cognify_caiq_questions_v1.pdf — it highlights the high-priority controls. If you need a narrower sample set for legal reasons, let me know which sub-controls you cannot share.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30m call if useful.

Regards,
Ava Patel
Security Program Manager
Cognify (on behalf of Solstice Health)

--- Attachment: cognify_caiq_questions_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <security@cognify.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync — scope & log samples request

Hi Ava — thanks for the CAIQ and the highlights. High level: we can provide the artifacts you requested, with a few constraints around tenant-specific payload redaction and vendor-owned keys. Proposed plan below.

What we can deliver:
- IAM / isolation: request/response trace excerpts (headers + tenant_id) for 3 representative calls, anonymized except for tenant_id mapping file.
- KMS rotation: KMS audit entries showing rotation events (timestamp, key-id, rotation-initiator) — we will redact customer-specific ARNs and substitute with mapping table.
- Telemetry retention: sample ingestion timeline and TTL enforcement logs (router checkpoint + retention job run excerpts).

Owners (first pass):
- IAM / isolation: Priyom Das (engineering ops)
- KMS rotation: Kimberly Park (security eng liaison)
- Telemetry & retention: Marissa Cole (observability lead)

Handover process and timeline:
- We will prepare an encrypted tar.gz containing redacted artifacts per our log_sample_instructions.md (attached).
- Proposed secure transfer window: Oct 28 09:00–17:00 PST or Oct 29 09:00–12:00 PST. Please confirm which slot works for your intake team.
- Delivery mechanism: time-limited pre-signed S3 URL with AES-256 encrypted payload + SHA256 checksum. We can also accept SFTP if you prefer — call that out.

Action items for me (today):
1) Circulate log_sample_instructions.md to owners (attached).
2) Confirm exact sub-controls you need from the PDF (Ava) so we scope redactions.
3) Schedule handover window and send DocuSign access link for credentials exchange.

If you want a short walkthrough I can have Priyom or Kimberly join the call to answer control-level questions.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync — scope & log samples request

Thanks Logan — quick follow-up after I reviewed the instructions:

- We should include a SHA256 manifest inside the encrypted bundle and publish the checksum to the DocuSign link so Solstice can verify integrity on download.
- For KMS rotation entries, we will replace customer ARNs with stable pseudonyms in the mapping file ("tenant-001" etc.) and include a redaction policy note.
- Marissa — can you confirm you or one of your on-call observability engineers can be available during the Oct 28 window (preferred) for a 30m verification check?

Ava — if you confirm Oct 28 morning (09:00–11:00 PST) we will lock that slot and put together the encrypted bundle by EOD Oct 27. I'll also add a link to the DocuSign credential envelope here: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/signon?envelopeId=ABC123-EXAMPLE
